author: Murphh
body:
Hi Seniors!

After playing on the scrim server yesterday, I have a few questions and requests.

1) Is it okay for everyone to be using 'creative mode' during the scrim or only the leaders?  
We were making a custom PVP battle arena and it was necessary for everyone to be in creative to help design the arena. Just checking in to make sure that's okay.

2) Can a few more loved maps be added to https://maps.avicus.net/atlas/ maybe the storage folder (idk)?
Our team would like to play on some older maps like...
  • TheFall - CTH
  • Gladiator-TDM
  • Luar-DTM
  • Ravanged-TDM
  • YinYang-TDM
  • Illuminati-TDM
I didn't try to access any of these maps yet, but I couldn't find them in any folders under 'atlas', so I'm assuming we can't play them.

 3) Are there any others scrim server commands that I need? or should know about?
/start
/end
/cycle
/sn [map]  <====== Is it true that I can only /setnext during a match? I get error messages a lot.
/scrim invite [teamtag]
/scrim invite -p [player]
/gamemode 0/1 [player]   <==== Can I globally set all players to a certain gamemode?

Thanks in advance for the feedback!! :)

title: Scrim Server Questions/Requests

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
1)
It's your scrim server so you would be fine. Just don't abuse during actual matches against other teams.

2)
Unless the map developers have a reason to add these maps other than for everyone's enjoyment on scrim servers, then it's a no because we don't really need these maps in our repository unless we have certain events for throwback. Also CTH isn't a thing so even if you wanted The Fall, there would be no kits and it would only be KOTH

3)
Those are the only commands that you need
